With adjoining rooms decorated for the Carnival Masquerade.

@@U02319@@
Forget for once you're in German lands, where Devils and Dunces and Death dance wildly. Today we're to have a bright and lusty revelry! On his journey to Rome, our great and Holy Emperor saw to his own profit, yes, but us he didn’t forget, he saw to us, too, to our pleasure, too. Crossing the lofty Alps, he saw a land of infinite cheer, of unspeakable and eternal brightness, and, seeing, he conquered it. Then kneeling humbly to the Holy Father, he bent low to receive the right to rule; and though he went to fetch a golden crown, he fetched for us, too, in his infinite wisdom, the Fool’s Cap and Carnival Mask. Now born anew in a festive mood, every man of us, worldly wise, pulls it down snugly over head and ears, and though he plays the Fool with wild and rowdy abandon, he remains as wise as ever he was. I see them there already, thronging and swaying this way and that,

毗邻的房间为嘉年华化装舞会而装饰。

一旦你来到了德国土地，就忘掉这里吧，那里魔鬼、笨蛋和死亡疯狂地跳舞。今天我们要来一场明快而热烈的狂欢！在前往罗马的旅途中，我们伟大而神圣的皇帝看到了他自己的利益，是的，但他没有忘记我们，他也看到了我们，也看到了我们的快乐。越过高耸的阿尔卑斯山，他看到了一片充满无限欢乐、难以言喻的永恒光明的土地，看到了，他就征服了它。然后谦卑地向教宗跪下，接受统治权；尽管他去取金王冠，但他也以他无限的智慧为我们取来了愚人帽和狂欢节面具。现在，我们每个人都在节日的气氛中重获新生，世俗的聪明人都把它紧紧地拉到头上和耳朵上，尽管他狂野而粗暴地扮演愚人，但他仍然像以前一样聪明。我已经看到他们在那里，拥挤不堪，摇摇晃晃，
